overall_summary: Most videos show low single-digit to double-digit views, indicating the channel is in early testing stages with limited distribution. However, a slight outlier outside the main niche (Maa Shayari at 156 views) outperformed the core self-respect digital-cleanup niche, though sample sizes are too small to declare a definitive niche shift. Core content heavily relies on repetitive digital cleanup hooks (chats, archives, block lists) which may be fatiguing the current audience.

winning_patterns.pattern: Universal emotional triggers beyond romantic heartbreak
winning_patterns.evidence: The Maa-related video (OfHrAp3r1G8) achieved 156 views and 16 likes, significantly higher than the average 10-20 views of technical digital-cleanup posts.
winning_patterns.action: Reserve a small experiment budget to test broader emotional pillars (like family or unconditional bonds) alongside the core self-respect content.

weak_patterns.evidence: Multiple consecutive videos about deleting chats, archive folders, and keyboards (e.g., W0ozRrwvigQ, aqzDPbQVnb0, djEm2iCAfqw) yielded low engagement and flat view counts (under 30 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid recycling the exact same smartphone/app cleanup metaphors back-to-back; diversify physical and mental markers of self-respect.

next_video.concept: A short emotional piece about changing the physical arrangement of a room or desk to remove reminders of someone, leading to an unexpected sense of personal freedom.
